Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: clinical documentation summarization across inpatient workflows.
- Success metrics: 75% reduction in initial note drafting time; redact PHI pipeline required.
- Top concerns: data residency, SOC2 scope, and procurement timeline for a contract.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (45–60m) with our platform + security follow-on — we should include your security and procurement reps.
2) I attached a short procurement checklist to accelerate internal approvals.
3) If you can share 2x preferred windows this week (or next), I will lock the calendar and pull in Karthik (technical lead) and Mina (security).

Two quick windows I can offer:
- Thu, Sep 9: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Mon, Sep 13: 14:00–15:00 PT

If neither works, send your best availability and we'll adapt.

Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

Thanks — Marissa
